Dear Lavaan Users;

I want to get some help for Lavaan Users.

I was performing the CFA model, one is the normal CFA model; the other is second-ordered CFA model.

There was no problem with the normal CFA model; but I was getting the warning about some estimated variances are negative when I was trying to perform second-ordered CFA model.

So I was checking and trying some solution in this forum via search (e.g. MLR Estimation), but I cannot have any confidence about my second-ordered CFA solution.

Here are my syntaxes and results when I performed the CFA models.

My Estimated standardized coefficients are okay?
